title: Two peers on spirit-3
why: The everyday working world, but reachable the way a real one is: both peers hold rows on the public relay, so presence, posting and the router are exercised over TLS and Caddy rather than over loopback. The lab relay still exists underneath — labWorld builds one and every peer claims there first — so this is 'also on spirit-3', which is the honest description of what a node with two relays actually has.
look: Contacts — two people, both green, reached through the public relay
Natter — two rows, the lab one and spirit.andyflinn.com
